section_summary.extract_value: This section presents an exploratory factor analysis (EFA) of the BAS-2 scale conducted on two gender-based subsamples: Malay female (n=149) and Malay male (n=157). For both subsamples, parallel analysis indicated that a single factor should be extracted, explaining 54.5% of variance in females and 49.83% in males, with good to fair factor loadings and omega reliability of .88 for both groups. Tucker's congruence coefficient of .85 suggested similar but not equal factor structures across the two subsamples.
